name: MPU-6050 6-axis IMU (GY-521 board)
description: 3-axis accelerometer + 3-axis gyro on I2C (address 0x68). The GY-521 board has a 3.3 V regulator and I2C pull-ups.
notes: The chip runs at 3.3 V (VDD 2.375-3.46 V); the board LDO lets VCC be 3.3-5 V.

SDA/SCL are pulled up to the board 3.3 V with 4.7 kOhm (some boards 2.2 kOhm or 10 kOhm). With a 5 V Arduino this works because I2C only pulls low, but turn off the Arduino internal pull-ups if you can.
I/O absolute max is VDD + 0.5 V (about 3.8 V): never drive SDA/SCL/AD0 from a push-pull 5 V output.
Board pull-up values and the regulator part differ between clones. Check yours if you put many I2C boards on one bus.

pins.name: VCC
pins.label: VCC
pins.note: Feeds an onboard 3.3 V LDO (662K / XC6206-type). 3.3-5 V in; at 3.3 V in the chip runs at about 3.1 V, which is fine.

pins.name: XDA
pins.label: XDA
pins.note: Auxiliary I2C master for an external magnetometer. Leave unconnected.

pins.name: AD0
pins.label: AD0
pins.note: Address select: LOW/unconnected = 0x68 (4.7 kOhm pull-down on the board), HIGH (3.3 V) = 0x69.

pins.name: INT
pins.label: INT
pins.note: Interrupt output (3.3 V push-pull by default).
